articleTitle: Optimization Scheduling Method for Multi-Microgrid Systems Based on Three Black Hole System Capture Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: To facilitate energy exchange among multiple microgrids operated by diverse stakeholders within the same region, considering the distinct interests of microgrids (MGs) and microgrid aggregators (MAs), We present a method for optimizing and scheduling a multi-microgrid system's economics using the Three Black Hole System Particle Swarm Optimization strategy. Black hole particles in MPSO-TCS can constantly update their positions, enhance the global search ability of the algorithm, and have good convergence and can approach the real pareto frontier. Initially, a framework is designed where MAs respond to internal electricity prices set by the MMGA, aiming to minimize operational costs of individual microgrids at the upper level and maximize MMGA's revenue at the lower level. The simulation findings confirm that the suggested approach improves economic advantages for all stakeholders by minimizing electricity exchange with the main grid. This facilitates the amalgamation of locally scattered resources, ensuring the power grid operates securely and steadily.

articleTitle: Grid-forming Control of Permanent Magnet Direct Drive Wind Turbine Based on VSG
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the escalating integration of wind power into energy grids, a series of challenges have emerged, notably low rotational inertia and diminished system robustness. To address these issues, grid-forming converters, characterized by their voltage source properties, have been proposed. These converters can autonomously establish AC side voltage and synchronize with the grid without relying on a phase-locked loop (PLL). This capability makes them particularly effective in mitigating the challenges posed by increased wind power penetration rates. In this paper, we apply Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) technology to permanent magnet direct drive wind turbine systems. Through simulation analysis under various operating conditions, we compare the operational characteristics between grid-following and grid-forming control strategies. Our findings illustrate that grid-forming direct drive wind turbines can effectively provide frequency and voltage support capabilities, especially in weak grid scenarios. This underscores the potential of VSG technology to enhance the resilience and stability of modern power systems facing high levels of renewable energy integration.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet direct drive wind turbine

articleTitle: ZnO/Ga2O3 Optoelectronic Device with Wide Response Wavelength
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)

articleTitle: The Power Decoupling Control Strategy for the Reinjection Multilevel Voltage Source Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The Reinjection Multilevel Voltage Source Converter (RMVSC) offers unique advantages in reducing switching frequency and lowering harmonic content, which makes it widely used in various fields. However, RMVSC has only one control variable (the firing angle), preventing it from simultaneously controlling both active and reactive power transmission as Pulse Width Modulation (PWM). To address this issue, this paper proposes a power decoupling control strategy based on series-connected submodule RMVSC, introducing dc voltage as an additional control variable. A dual-loop controller, consisting of an outer power loop and an inner current loop, is designed to achieve power decoupling. Finally, a control model is constructed by simulation to verify the feasibility and practicality of the control strategy, providing a new approach for power decoupling in RMVSC.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Analysis and Calculation Method of Wind Turbine Based on Single Byte Power Band Probability Distribution and Edge Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: A scatter plot with wind speed and power as the horizontal and vertical axes is established, and the horizontal power band and vertical wind speed band are divided to form several wind speed and power grids. The probability distribution of each grid in each horizontal power band is calculated, and the probability distribution data of the horizontal power band is mapped to an integer value of 0 ~ 255.The main power band of wind turbine is extracted by image edge detection technology. Through statistical calculation of normal points, overgeneration points, undergeneration points and limited power points of the main power band, the power generation performance of the wind turbine in a certain period of time can be analyzed, so as to realize the energy efficiency analysis of the wind turbine. Taking the actual operation data of wind turbine as an example, the effectiveness of this method in identifying abnormal data is verified.

articleTitle: Improvement Method of Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Stability Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In this paper, a new approach based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology is proposed to solve the voltage fluctuation problem caused by grid-connected PV. A hybrid grid-connected PV-storage system is integrated by optimising the VSG control strategy. It not only provides the necessary damping and inertia to the grid, but also improves the dynamic reactive power support. By comparing the effects of PV systems with different grid connected capacities and locations under four control methods, the significant impact of grid connected location and capacity on power quality is revealed. The study clearly shows that the VSG grid-connected control method in combination with photovoltaic storage is more advantageous in increasing the grid-connected node voltage and reducing the harmonic distortion rate of the grid-connected current. The experiments show that the proposed method can increase the voltage by 1.29% and reduce the harmonic distortion rate to 1.11% for the same capacity compared to the traditional network connection method. This study not only provides valuable theoretical guidance, but also a practical reference for the design and management of future distribution networks.

articleTitle: A Precision Aggregation Method for Large-scale Inverter Air-conditioners based on Minkowski Sum
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: To deal with the phenomenon of insufficient flexibility for new power system, a solution idea is provided by tap the demand response potential of inverter air-conditioner (IAC) with high-quality adjustment ability. Due to the wide dispersion, different parameters and high heterogeneity of IAC, the dispatching difficulty of power grid increases sharply and the calculation is complex. A precision aggregation method for large-scale IAC based on Minkowski sum is proposed. Firstly, to better track the operation performance of IAC with high heterogeneity, a basic model of IAC is established based on the bottom-up idea. Secondly, to reduce the load of grid scheduling calculation and satisfy the privacy protection problem of end-users, the feasible region of individual IAC elastic regulation is described based on virtual battery (VB) model, and the charging and discharging power and energy boundary of VB are determined based on optimization method. Finally, the VB model of IAC is represented by Polytopes semi-plane, and then the further approximation aggregated by Minkowski sum method, forming the external characteristic characterization form of cluster. The results show that the proposed method can effectively and accurately aggregate large-scale IACs with high heterogeneity.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Evaluation Method for Transmission Power and Line Loss of 10 kV Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Due to the complex power fluctuations and unstable environmental conditions in power systems, accurately measuring the transmitted power and line losses presents numerous difficulties. To enhance the accuracy of line loss prediction and power transmission measurement, this paper introduces the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network combined with the integral method to accurately calculate the transferred power in 10kV lines. By collecting current and voltage signals over a specified period and integrating these values, the amount of electrical energy transmitted by the line can be determined. The GRU algorithm is then used to predict line losses based on the current and voltage signals and the line loss values. Accurate transmitted power (transferred power) can be obtained by subtracting the predicted line losses from the integrated power calculation. The effectiveness and practicality of this method are validated by comparing the calculated transmitted power with actual measurements taken at various time intervals.

articleTitle: A Study on Passive Control Strategies for Specific Sub-Harmonic Suppression in Grid-Connected LCL Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In the process of grid-connected operation of microgrid, the current of grid-connected inverter is prone to distortion phenomenon due to the influence of grid voltage harmonics and switching characteristics, while the existence of nonlinear loads also affects the grid-connected current, which affects the system stability and the quality of grid-connected current. For this reason, a specific subharmonic current suppression method based on passive control is proposed for the three-phase grid-connected inverter in this paper. Firstly, the PCHD mathematical model of the three-phase grid-connected inverter is established and the current loop passive controller is designed; then the compensation loop is introduced with the multiple reference fame (MRF) method to control the harmonic currents independently; Finally, a system simulation model is built to verify the effectiveness of the adopted control strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed control method can effectively improve the power quality of the grid-connected current with the advantages of passive control.

articleTitle: Research on VSG Control of Three-Phase Four-Leg Power Conversion System Considering Power Oscillation Suppression under Unbalanced Fault
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In this paper, we explore the challenges associated with power oscillation and active support in four-leg inverters during unbalanced fault conditions. To address these issues, we propose a Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control strategy specifically designed to suppress power oscillations while providing active support to the grid. The key innovation of this strategy lies in the control of zero-sequence current, which plays a crucial role in ensuring that power oscillations are effectively mitigated. Simultaneously, the strategy guarantees that the output current from the four-leg inverter does not exceed safety thresholds, thereby protecting the system from potential damage. Furthermore, when an unbalanced fault occurs within the power grid, leading to frequency disturbances, the proposed Automatic Generation Control (AGC) function is activated. This function ensures the continued suppression of power oscillations even amidst these disruptions. The effectiveness of our proposed control strategy has been thoroughly validated through comprehensive simulations, demonstrating its potential for real-world applications in enhancing grid stability.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Scheduling of Microgrid Integrated Energy Storage under Uncertain Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The development of microgrids aims to meet the basic requirements of power supply while improving economic and environmental protection benefits. Energy storage devices play an important role in balancing power fluctuations of microgrids caused by renewable energy sources and load uncertainty. This paper proposed a multi-objective scheduling method for microgrids contain energy storage to minimize both operation and maintenance costs as well as environmental pollution costs. An improved non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) is proposed to solve the model. A penalty ranking mechanism is introduced in the improved NSGA-II algorithm, which is able to reach the optimal solution faster. Meanwhile, a fast forward elimination way based on probabilistic distance is used to obtain renewable energy typical scenarios. Simulation results verify the viability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Load Frequency Controller for Power System Based on Equivalent Input Disturbance Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In the power system, due to the instability of the external environment, safe and stable operation cannot always be guaranteed, as it frequently encounters varying degrees of external disturbances. In order to mitigate the effects of these disturbances on the system, the power system can operate safely and stably, In this paper, a power system load frequency control (LFC) based on Equivalent Input Disturbance (EID) method is proposed from the perspective of active disturbance suppression. Firstly, the disturbances present in the environment are unified as external disturbances, and then a single area the electric power system model with external disturbance was constructed. Then, a controller algorithm based on EID was designed using EID equivalent processing method and linear matrix inequality method to address the issue of external interference in the power system. Finally, a numerical example is used to validate the effectiveness and accuracy of the controller by simulating with two aspects, fixed perturbation and random perturbation, respectively.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Optimization of Regenerative Energy Recovery Technology for Pure Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to improve the driving distance of pure electric vehicles, an improved regenerative energy recovery technology is proposed for different cyclic working conditions. Firstly, the vehicle dynamics model and motor model are analyzed to determine the factors that affect the energy recovery efficiency of the vehicle regenerative braking system. Secondly, according to their influencing factors, the regenerative energy recovery strategy based on fuzzy control uses genetic algorithm to improve its parameters. Finally, the regenerative energy recovery strategy is modeled based on MATLAB and embedded in Carsim for experiments. The results show that the control strategy proposed in this paper improves the braking energy recovery efficiency by 11.6% and 8.3% under the two operating conditions of NEDC and WLTC respectively, and improves the endurance of pure electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Optimal Electric Heating Load Dispatch Strategy with CNN-BiLSTM-Attention and IGDT Interactive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Adopting electric energy to replace traditional coalfired and gas-fired heating methods is conducive to energy utilization and safety. In order to reduce the influence of the uncertainty of distribution and randomness output on the electric heating loads, an optimized electric heating load dispatch strategy is proposed to address this issue based on the interaction between the CNN-BiLSTM-Attention load forecast and the IGDT decision approach. Firstly, a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model is employed to forecast distributed electric heating loads, integrating different load characteristics. Secondly, a dispatch strategy is proposed to maximize economic efficiency to ensure optimal thermal comfort for electric energy heating load users. Considering the uncertainty of the user behaviors, the IGDT decision model is introduced under the risky speculative strategy to find the maximized benefit. Then, through the data-driven forecast and decision-making interactions, an enhanced particle swarm algorithm is employed to derive the optimal dispatch results. Finally, the simulation strategy results illustrate that the proposed approach incorporates the characteristics of electric heating loads and improves the revenue of the load users.

articleTitle: Case Analysis of Emergency Control Negative Effect in Frequency-Angle Coupling Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: An AC fault in the vicinity of a UHVDC cluster within same sending and receiving ends may trigger simultaneous blockings of these multiple UHVDC lines. Implementing emergency control measures such as nearby generator shedding are necessary to address the substantial power surplus in the sending grid of UHVDC. However, prevailing control strategies are formulated with a primary focus on the mitigation of imbalance active power and frequency regulation objectives. However, the potential negative effect of control actions on angle stability has been neglected. With a focus on a specific actual power grid in China, the mechanism of negative effects on angle stability of generator shedding after multi-UHVDC locking faults is analyzed by applying EEAC theory. Building upon this analysis, a strategy for identifying appropriate emergency control measures is proposed based on the ratio of active power output to inertia of generators as a guiding metric.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Supercapacitor SOC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to avoid the frequent overruns of supercapacitor in the process of smoothing power fluctuation of DC microgrid by hybrid energy storage and to extend its available time, a hybrid energy storage power allocation strategy based on fuzzy control is proposed. The method firstly divides five different working areas according to the SOC of supercapacitor, takes the SOC of supercapacitor as a variable, establishes the corresponding functional relationship with the filtering time constant in different working areas, and then corrects the filtering time constant based on the fuzzy control in order to realize the reasonable distribution of the power between the battery and the supercapacitor, and to ensure that the SOC of the supercapacitor is maintained within a reasonable range. The relevant model is built and simulated under MATLAB/Simulink, and the simulation results show that the control strategy proposed in the article can carry out reasonable power allocation according to the SOC of the supercapacitor while suppressing the power fluctuation, so that the SOC of the supercapacitor can recover on its own, preventing it from being over-charged and over-discharged, and improving the economy and stability of the operation of the DC microgrid system.

articleTitle: VSC Control in Grid Connected PV Plant for Power Generation and Harmonics Mitigation During Partial Shading Irradiance Condition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The main objective of the work presented in this paper is the control and power quality enhancement of a photovoltaic system connected to a high voltage electrical grid. The system under study is composed of 400 kW PV field connected to a 66 kV grid via a DC/DC boost converter and a three-phase VSC (Voltage Source Converter). A smart control of the PV array power is realized using fuzzy logic technique. In addition, the grid current waveform improvement is ensured by suppressing the harmonic currents generated by the DC/AC PWM converter. To do this task, a passive LCL filter is designed to filter these harmonics to obtain a current THD (Total Harmonic Distortion) level of less than 5%. The effectiveness of the proposed filtering strategy is tested in terms of grid current depollution for different levels of power injection under partial shading irradiance condition. It verifies that the THD of the obtained grid current is according to IEEE Std 519-2014 harmonic limits.

articleTitle: Control of Voltage Level in Railway Contact Network Using IGBT Booster Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Controlling the voltage level in the contact network of railways is an important task, since it ensures the throughput capacity of the section and reduces power losses. However, the use of voltage regulation devices can lead to the deterioration in the electric power quality. For example, the use of booster transformers leads to the deterioration in the coefficient of voltage asymmetry in the negative sequence. To overcome this drawback, the authors proposed a traction power supply circuit with a booster transformer, which implies the presence of a switch and a voltage sensor at the sectioning post. A detailed description of the operation of this circuit is given. The role of each element in controlling the voltage level in the contact network is described. The switch switches the supply winding of the IGBT booster transformer to different phases of the step-down transformer depending on the value of the traction load. In this case, the amount of voltage boost is calculated taking into account the readings of the voltage sensor at the sectioning post. Due to this, the required voltage level in the contact network is ensured and the coefficient of voltage asymmetry in the negative sequence is improved. The article provides an example that proves the improvement of power quality indicators using the proposed voltage level control scheme in the contact network.

articleTitle: A Cybersecurity Entity Recognition Method for Enhancing Situation Awareness in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The intrusion detection system (IDS) within the power system detects network anomalies and activates alarms by matching rules. To address the evolving landscape of network attack methods, continuous updates to the ruleset are necessary. The integration of threat intelligence knowledge into the ruleset is crucial for enhancing the system’s security awareness and response capabilities. The prevailing approach involves leveraging NLP techniques for intelligence extraction, in which NER is a key step. Due to the complexity and variability of entity names, achieving high-precision NER is challenging. In this study, a novel method that combines RoBERTa, Bi-GRU, and CRF is proposed. By utilizing RoBERTa’s comprehensive semantic word vectors and Bi-GRU embedded with attention mechanisms, the method enhances feature extraction capabilities. This approach aims to achieve high-precision recognition of security-related entities, thereby enhancing the system’s ability to extract valuable insights from threat intelligence.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Multiple Energy Storage-Thermal Power Units under Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Aiming at the increasing burden of power system peaking caused by the integration of large-scale new energy generation into the grid and the imperfect participation mechanisms for peaking entities in the power market, this paper proposes an optimal dispatch method for multiple storage and thermal power units. Firstly, to reduce the impact of the volatility of new energy generation on system peaking, the planned market trading power of new energy is optimally allocated with the goal of minimizing the net load on the grid. Secondly, a multi-storage lease transaction mechanism and an energy storage lease declaration model based on the whole life cycle cost are designed, and the charging and discharging power of individual storage units is optimized with the objective of maximizing revenue from multi-storage leasing. Finally, typical daily data are selected and simulated in the improved IEEE 30-bus system. The results show that the proposed method reduces the curtailment rate of new energy and effectively improves the economic efficiency of peaking for power market entities.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Reinforcement Device for Truss-type Material Ropeway Crossbeam
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In the transmission line engineering, the large size of the crossbeam components of heavy-duty material ropeway increases the workload of the personnel on the construction site and poses higher risks to construction safety. Taking the crossbeam of a duplex-bearing rope material ropeway with a rated bearing capacity of 200kN in a certain project as an example, this paper proposes a reinforced device for truss-type material ropeway crossbeam. According to the finite element analysis, the traditional scheme usually adopts a 25a duplex I-steel structure to meet the bearing requirements, while the structure assembled with the device and the small-sized 18 duplex I-steel crossbeam can also meet the same bearing requirements. The device can reduce the weight of duplex I-steel by up to 36.6%. Under the rated load, the safety factor of the crossbeam with the device is greater than 2.5, which meets the requirements of strength and stiffness. The critical buckling load of the device is greater than the bearing capacity of the crossbeam, meeting the stability requirements. The device is designed ingeniously and can be quickly assembled with the small-sized crossbeam through simple bolt connection. This study aims to propose a reinforced device for the crossbeam components of material ropeway in transmission line engineering, providing new ideas and directions for the lightweight design of crossbeam components. It has important practical significance and application value in reducing construction costs, improving construction efficiency, and ensuring construction safety.

articleTitle: Level-Switching Control Strategy for Reinjection Multilevel Current-Source Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: When the device is running, the device is prone to failure due to various reasons such as environmental factors, which affects the normal operation. When the injection multilevel current source rectifier is running, the injection branch on the DC side is faulty, resulting in a change in the number of injection branches. Because the branch currents are not equal, the injection branch loses the ability to eliminate harmonics and damages its normal operating characteristics. Analyzes the fault characteristics in the injection branch and identifies the main causes for low-order current harmonics generated on the grid side. A level smooth switching control strategy based on RMCSC is presented. The working principle of the strategy is analyzed in detail, and the logical reasoning principle is given. And more enough to keep the output current and power stability to maintain the branch's current balance. Finally, PSCAD simulation is conducted to verify the effectiveness and rationality of this level-switching control strategy.

articleTitle: Improved Critical Clear Time Calculation for Grid-Forming Converter Based on Accurate Power Angle Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Grid-Forming (GFM) technique is a novel solution for renewable energy sources to mimic the conventional synchronous generator behavior and to provide inertia, frequency and voltage support for the electricity grids. The transient stability of GFM converters is a matter of concern and the fault clear time has significant impacts on the transient stability. However, in the traditional critical clear time (CCT) calculation under grid faults, the GFM converter is regarded as a synchronous machine and its low overcurrent ability is ignored, hence such study is inconsistent with the practical applications, resulting in inaccurate analysis of the CCT. To quantitatively analyze the transient stability margin of GFM converters with current limiting strategies, a CCT calculation method is proposed in this paper. The analysis results show that the proposed method has higher precision and wider applicability. The effectiveness of the theoretical analysis is verified by the Matlab/Simulink-based simulations.

articleTitle: 400mm2 Wire Clamp Nozzle Based on Finite Element Analysis Structural Optimization Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Accidents involving wire breakage in overhead line construction due to broken jaw pliers in cable clamps are mainly caused by the design of the clamping mouth of the wire clipper. This paper first introduces the structure and features of existing parallel movement of the wire clipper and multi-plate bolt wire of the wire clipper. A finite element model of the cable clamp and wire is established, and the boundary conditions and loading are determined. Two structural optimization design solutions for the clamping mouth of the wire clipper are provided, including optimization Design of the clamping mouth of the wire clipper and arc shaped design of the clamping mouth of the wire clipper. Through the analysis, it is found that the new designed arc-shaped jaw pliers of the cable clamp are significantly less likely to damage the aluminum strands of the wire compared to the original jaw pliers, thereby improving the safety and efficiency of the tensioning construction of the wire clipper.

articleTitle: Analysis of Charging Methods for Inner Mongolia Power Grid 220kV System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: This article combines the 220kV system of the 500kV substation in the main grid of Inner Mongolia Grid to explore the busbar structure and common dead zone faults of the 220kV system. The faults are removed through bus differential protection and failure protection. The analysis focuses on the need to charge the equipment before operation due to infrastructure, production, and other projects. This article discusses the characteristics of two charging methods, and proposes that for the charging of new equipment, the charging method based on the protection device's logic of charging to the dead zone should be selected to reduce the scope of removal, avoid potential hazards, and ensure the stable and reliable operation of the power grid. Through simulation experiments, the charging method based on the dead zone logic of the bus differential protection can accurately isolate faults without expanding the power outage area, significantly enhancing the reliability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Forecasting China’s Electric Power Digitalization Scale Using a Unified New-information-Priority Accumulating Generation Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In an era of rapid technological evolution, China’s electric power industry is undergoing a significant transformation toward digitalization. Accordingly, accurately forecasting this digitalization scale is crucial for strategic planning and policy-making. However, traditional forecasting methods often struggle to keep pace with the sector’s dynamic changes and sparse data. Addressing this need, our study introduces the Unified New Information Accumulating Generation Operator (UNAGO), integrated into the Discrete Grey Model (DGM (1,1)), to enhance forecasting accuracy. UNAGO can effectively handle the complexities of the rapidly evolving sectors often characterized by limited data. It prioritizes new information within data sequences, offering a more nuanced and adaptable accumulating weights structure compared to traditional AGOs. For comparison purposes, UNAGO is contrasted to five previously proposed AGO techniques. The results indicate UNAGO’s superior prediction accuracy with 4.24% and 1.66% out-of-sample MAPE values. Applying the UNAGO-DGM (1,1) model, we forecasted the scale of electric power digitalization in China from 2021 to 2025. The model projects a substantial growth from 414 billion Yuan in 2021 to 643.23 billion Yuan by 2025. To conclude, the results not only advance the theoretical aspects of the grey prediction model but also offer practical insights for stakeholders in China’s electric power sector. The model’s predictions serve as a valuable tool for informed decision-making, guiding strategic planning, investment, technological innovation, and policy formulation in a sector poised for significant digital transformation.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling and Simulation Verification of Dual-Excited Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The dual-excited synchronous generator has two sets of independently adjustable excitation windings. This unique rotor structure makes it have better stability than the single-excited synchronous generator. However, as the most widely used simulation software, the MATLAB/Simulink platform does not have a corresponding dual-excited synchronous generator simulation model. In order to carry out relevant research work in the MATLAB/Simulink platform, it is necessary to establish a simulation model of the dual-excited synchronous generator and directly verify the correctness of this simulation model from the simulation model level. Based on the establishment of the dual-excited synchronous generator simulation model, this paper compares the simulation results of the no-load test and short-circuit test of the single-excited synchronous generator and the dual-excited synchronous generator, and illustrates the correctness of the dual-excited synchronous generator simulation model from the simulation level. The research results can increase the credibility of the dual-excited synchronous generator simulation model in the MATLAB/Simulink platform and lay the foundation for its in-depth research.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategies of Energy Storage Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: At present, clean energy represented by wind and solar energy is gradually replacing traditional fossil energy. However, due to the instability of clean energy itself, it will affect the safe and stable operation of the power grid. The wind turbine is connected to the grid with power electronic devices. The decoupling characteristics of the output power of the unit and the system frequency weaken the inertial response ability of the system and affect the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Considering the negative impact of the increase in clean energy penetration on the safe operation of the power system, the existing energy storage devices in the system can participate in the frequency regulation of the power grid and improve the frequency stability of the power system. This paper mainly studies the primary frequency regulation control of the power grid by using wind turbine and energy storage system.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet direct drive wind turbine
the state of charge of energy storage

articleTitle: Research on SOH Estimation Method of Lithium-ion Battery based on Fusion of VMD and SVR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Precisely estimating the State of Health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries is crucial for their safe and reliable operation. To solve the problem of insufficient accuracy in current state-of-health (SOH) estimations for lithium-ion batteries, this paper proposes an SOH estimation method based on Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and Support Vector Regression (SVR). Initially, the aging data from parameters such as voltage, current, and temperature during the charging process of lithium-ion batteries is analyzed. Secondly, through correlation analysis, the correlation analysis of health indicators and capacity decay of lithium-ion batteries is carried out, with four features identified and modal components obtained through VMD decomposition. Finally, SVR is used as the model to estimate the SOH of lithium-ion batteries. Based on the lithium-ion battery public dataset from the Toyota Research Institute (TRI), the experimental results show that the RMSE, MAE, and MAPE of the proposed method are 0.175%, 0.223%, and 0.176%, respectively. This indicates that the proposed method can accurately estimate SOH.

articleTitle: Small Signal Stability Analysis of Grid-Connected Converter Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the installed capacity of new energy sources in advanced power systems, the capability for voltage control in grids becomes increasingly weak. Grid-connected renewable energy converters, due to their inherent voltage support capabilities, are particularly favored in weak grid scenarios. However, current research on the characteristics of such grid-connected renewable energy converters is still inconclusive, and there is an urgent need for an analysis of their stability properties. This paper addresses the issue of stability in single-machine grid-connected systems of these converters by deriving a small signal model for a grid-connected renewable energy converter in a single-machine grid connection system. Through eigenvalue analysis of the model's characteristics, the study further validates the correctness of this analysis by constructing a model in Matlab/Simulink and performing Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis on the active power output of the model. By combining the examination of system eigenvalue root loci with analyses of the active power output from simulation models, the paper investigates the impact of factors such as line connection impedance, parameters of active power loop control, and parameters of reactive power loop control on the low-frequency oscillation modes of the system. This comprehensive approach not only deepens our understanding of the stability characteristics of grid-connected renewable energy converters but also provides a practical methodology for assessing and optimizing the control strategies in the context of an increasingly renewables-dominated grid infrastructure.

articleTitle: Corrosion Rate Prediction of Substation Grounding Network Based on Dung Beetle Algorithm Optimised Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of corrosion rate prediction of substation grounding network, this paper proposes a Support Vector Machine (SVM) prediction method based on Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO). Firstly, moisture content, soil resistivity, porosity, ${\text{S}}{{\text{O}}_4}^{2 - }$ and Cl<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> concentrations, and the corrosion rate of the grounding grid were selected as input variables for the prediction model. Then, the parameters of SVM were optimised using the DBO algorithm, so as to construct a prediction model for the corrosion rate of substation grounding network. Finally, a case study was carried out through the corrosion test data and compared with the effects of other prediction methods. The results show that the mean square error of the proposed model is 0.0118g•dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup>•a<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, the average absolute percentage error is 1.90%, the relative error standard deviation is 0.1214, and the error fluctuation is significantly lower than that of the other methods, showing higher prediction accuracy. This verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method for predicting the corrosion rate of substation grounding network.

articleTitle: Design of Comprehensive Evaluation System for Cable Joint Quality Based on Multi-Dimensional Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In urban power grids, the reliability of cable joints is crucial to the stability of the entire power supply system. In view of the common fault problems of cable joints, this study aims to develop a cable joint quality evaluation system based on intelligent algorithms. The system integrates a variety of detection technologies, such as X-ray detection, high-frequency current detection, etc., uses the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) to determine the weight of each detection data, and uses the random forest algorithm to perform comprehensive quality scoring and fault prediction. By introducing XGBoost and neural network algorithm (N-XGBoost), the system can learn historical detection data and continuously optimize the evaluation system. In practical applications, this evaluation system has been used in on-site inspections, and can effectively predict the smooth operating life of cable joints, and conduct on-site rectification of cable joints that do not meet standards. Through detailed case analysis, the effectiveness and practicality of the system are proved. Overall, this research provides an efficient and scientific evaluation method for the maintenance of cable joints, which significantly improves the operational safety and reliability of the power system.

articleTitle: A Wake Cooperative Control Method for Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The wake effect is one of the main factors limiting the maximum power generation of wind farms. The wake generated by upstream wind turbines can cause downstream wind speed to decrease, significantly reducing the generation power of downstream wind turbines. At present, wind tunnel experiment or numerical simulation is often used to study the wake effect, which is costly. Due to the limitations of operation and maintenance and the site, it is difficult to obtain the parameters of the above experimental model and analyze the wake state by deploying sensors in the wind field that has been put into operation. The existing algorithms are aimed at neatly arranged wind farms, and most of them are the same type of wind turbines in the field, and there is a lack of optimization research for the actual wind farms with complex arrangements. The technical problem solved in this paper is how to effectively identify and reduce the wake influence between wind turbines, and improve the overall operating efficiency and stability of wind farms by cooperating to control the yaw strategy of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Research on Prognostic Cost Model for Electric Drive Systems Integrating Material Pricing and Technological Evolution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In order to analyze the change trend of the cost and price of the electric drive system, a cost prediction model of the electric drive system based on the raw material price and technology upgrading factors is constructed. Through simulation, the cost of the electric drive system in 2025 and 2030 is calculated. The results show that with the continuous upgrading of technology and the continuous improvement of industrial chain, the cost of miniaturized electric drive system in 2025 will be reduced by about 20% compared with that in 2022, and by 2030, the cost of miniaturized electric drive system and high-voltage electric drive system will be reduced by more than 25% compared with that in 2022. Industrial scale, rare earth price, chip price, bulk commodities, silicon carbide and technology upgrading are the main factors affecting the cost of electric drive system.

articleTitle: Residential Electric Vehicle Charging Load Prediction Method Based on DBO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of the electric vehicle (EV) industry in China has significantly increased the pressure on the power grid due to the rising demand for EV charging. Accurate prediction of EV charging load is crucial for effective power grid planning and management. This paper presents a novel approach for predicting residential EV charging load by utilizing the Dung Beetle Optimized Extreme Learning Machine (DBO-ELM). The study identifies key factors influencing charging behavior, including battery State of Charge (SOC), time-of-use tariffs, and charging time, and constructs mathematical models for each. The DBO algorithm is employed to optimize the input weights and hidden layer biases of the ELM model, resulting in improved prediction accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the DBO-ELM model outperforms traditional ELM models in terms of prediction accuracy, making it a valuable tool for addressing the uncertainties and fluctuations in residential EV charging load.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Response Mechanism Based on Price Incentive Driven Directrix Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the development of the new power system, the new load aggregators urgently need to adopt a more rational scheduling scheme to cope with the uncertainty of the high proportion of new energy. In this paper, the customer directrix load (CDL) considering the price factor is proposed for load aggregator optimal dispatch. By introducing time-of-use electricity pricing and CDL-based demand response mechanism into the traditional optimal dispatch model, directrix load is constructed in the system constraints to guide adjustable loads to be allocated in the whole time period and balance the nonadjustable resources in the system. In order to incentivize users to actively participate in the system regulation, the load aggregator optimization scheduling model is established with the objectives of consuming new energy and saving users' electricity bills. The results show that the price incentive driven CDL can improve the system's wind energy consumption capacity and system revenue, and can effectively reduce the cost of electricity consumption.

articleTitle: A Novel Back Propagation Neural Network-square Root Cubature Kalman Filtering Strategy Based on Fusion Dual Factor Parameter Identification for State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Accurate real-time estimation of the state-of-charge (SOC) of the battery is of great significance for promoting the development of electric vehicles. In this research, a novel back propagation neural network-square root cubature Kalman filtering (BPNN-SRCKF) strategy based on fusion dual factor parameter identification for SOC estimation of lithium-ion batteries is proposed. First of all, with the organic integration of the forgetting factor and memory length, a dual factor parameter identification algorithm is designed. Secondly, the square root filtering is incorporated into the CKF algorithm to speed up the operation and avoid filter divergence. Finally, a BPNN is introduced to improve the fault tolerance of the model. The results show that the mean absolute error and root mean square error range from 1.13%~1.28% under complex working conditions, which proves that the proposed strategy has high precision and good robustness.

articleTitle: Regional Power Grid Automatic Generation Control Strategy Considering Energy Storage Participation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: In recent years, due to the high penetration rate of renewable energy and the diversification of load side resources, the uncertainty factors in the power system bring great challenges to the construction of the power market. To address the coordination issue of allocating frequency regulation resources such as energy storage, coal-fired units, and gas-fired units for area regulation requirements (ARR) in power grids, a control strategy based on energy storage participation in regional power grid automatic generation control (AGC) is proposed. Firstly, four regulation requirement zones for regional adjustment control are defined. Then, considering the allocation of large-scale energy storage for area regulation requirements, the regulation power of energy storage in regional power grid AGC is calculated and an optimized distribution strategy among energy storage stations to maintain the balance of state of charge (SOC) is developed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed energy storage participation in AGC control strategy was verified through case analysis using actual data from a specific region.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Voltage Sag Detection Method Based on Delay Small Angle Method and Moving Average Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: As one of the most influential power quality problems, voltage sag seriously threatens the normal operation of modern manufacturing, public service and other industries. The fast and accurate detection of voltage sag events is the first step to control voltage sag. The asymmetric short-circuit fault also introduces negative sequence component when it causes voltage sag, which poses a new challenge to voltage sag detection. The traditional voltage sag detection method based on single synchronous reference frame phase locked loop (SSRF-PLL) and instantaneous dq decomposition can’t detect the power grid voltage with negative sequence and harmonic components accurately and quickly. This paper presents a new method of asymmetric voltage sag detection based on delay small angle method and moving average filter. Firstly, the positive and negative sequence components of asymmetric voltage are separated by delay small-angle method combined with instantaneous symmetric component method, and then the amplitude information of the separated positive and negative sequence components is obtained by instantaneous dq transformation respectively. Finally, the harmonic components are filtered by half-period moving average filter, and the amplitude information of the positive and negative sequence components of fundamental voltage is obtained. The proposed method can detect asymmetrical voltage sags quickly and accurately. The simulation results based on PLECS simulation software prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Traceability Mechanism of Microgrid Green Energy Consumption Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: This paper provides an in-depth discussion on the green energy consumption and traceability mechanism of microgrids based on blockchain technology, aiming to enhance the transparency and efficiency of green power transactions. Firstly, it reviews the policy background and theoretical foundation related to green power and analyses the specific needs of microgrids for green power consumption. Based on these needs, a set of blockchain-covered tariff subsidy issuance model, a green power metering method that integrates data analysis and consensus mechanism, and a new blockchain-based green certificate trading scheme and its innovative mechanism for uploading process are designed. The proposed model and scheme are also analysed and optimised in terms of arithmetic cases. The research results demonstrate that the mechanism can effectively enhance the transparency and trustworthiness of green power transactions, providing an innovative and effective solution strategy for green energy consumption in microgrids.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Production Adaptive Control Method in Wind-Solar Combined DC Microgrid with Energy Storage Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The existing DC microgrid has inadequate absorption capacity for high proportion of renewable energy generation, which causes a large consumption of wind and photovoltaic power in the local grid. To tackle this challenge, a hydrogen production adaptive control (HPAC) method is proposed for improving the stability of remaining energy hydrogen production for enhancing the efficient use of renewable energy. The main content of HPAC method includes: 1) A wind-solar-storage combined power system with hydrogen production is established, which greatly improved the consumption capacity of renewable energy; 2) A adaptive hydrogen production control strategy is proposed, which can stably operate in various scenarios, including power supply sufficient (PSS) scenario, power supply insufficient (PSI) scenario, and hydrogen storage full (HSF) scenario; 3) An energy storage active power filter (ESAPF) solution is conducted, which achieves harmonic suppression for extending electrolyzers life while reducing the investment cost of filter unit. Extensive test results under various working scenarios are illustrated for verifying the correctness of proposed HPAC method.

articleTitle: Potential Assessment and Techno-economic Analysis of Concentrated Solar Power in Xizang Autonomous Region
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: With the steady advancement of China's "dual carbon goals", new energy sources are rapidly replacing traditional fossil fuels. Among these, concentrated solar power (CSP) generation has garnered significant attention due to its continuous, stable, and flexible power generation capabilities. CSP can reliably provide inertia support and spinning reserve services to the power system, and its thermal storage system allows for continuous and stable output around the clock. This makes it an ideal frequency and peak regulation power source in modern power systems. Xizang Autonomous Region, with its abundant solar resources and high demand for mining industry loads, is particularly suitable for large-scale CSP plant construction. This paper designs a geographic potential assessment method for CSP generation based on Geographic Information System (GIS) method and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) technologies, constructs a levelized cost of energy (LCOE) calculation model for Xizang. Eventually this paper assesses the CSP potential of Xizang and makes a techno-economic analysis of CSP generation in the region. The results indicate that Xizang has very high potential for CSP generation and good economic viability. Furthermore, with the rapid iteration of CSP plant construction and generation technologies, Xizang's CSP potential can be further enhanced, and costs can be further reduced in the future.

articleTitle: ADMM-Based Balanced Charging Strategy for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: The electric vehicle (EV) market is expanding rapidly, and using renewable energy to power EVs not only enhances environmental sustainability but also significantly reduces greenhouse gas emissions. As a result, more service providers are introducing EV fleets to promote sustainable development. However, EVs require specialized charging infrastructure, which presents technical and economic challenges. Therefore, developing smart charging strategies to optimize the EV fleet charging process is crucial. This paper proposes a convex optimization model aimed at minimizing energy costs and battery degradation costs to reduce the overall charging expenses for fleets. We employ an ADMM-based algorithm to solve this optimization problem and use a nonlinear battery model for degradation analysis, considering the relationship between charging power and battery degradation costs. Through a comparative analysis of three charging strategies—Greedy Charging, Minimal Energy Charging, and Balanced Charging—the results show that the Balanced Charging strategy is the most effective. It not only reduces battery degradation costs but also controls aggregator demand, relieves grid pressure, and achieves an optimal balance between cost and battery lifespan.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of a Blockchain-Based Carbon Emission Trading System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: As global climate change intensifies, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving carbon neutrality have become international priorities. In this context, carbon trading markets have emerged as a key mechanism to price emissions and incentivize reductions, promoting green development. For China, the world’s largest emitter, the development of its carbon market is not only critical for domestic environmental improvement but also for global climate governance. However, challenges such as incomplete market mechanisms, lack of regulatory independence, and low liquidity hinder its efficiency and broader participation. This paper conducts a comprehensive analysis of the current state and key challenges of China’s carbon market and proposes a blockchain-based solution to create a more transparent, secure, and efficient system. By utilizing blockchain’s features—such as decentralization, immutability, and enhanced security—the proposed system aims to streamline transactions, improve market liquidity, and foster trust among stakeholders. This approach not only addresses the immediate shortcomings of China’s carbon market but also positions it for sustainable long-term growth, aligning with global efforts to mitigate climate change and reduce carbon footprints.

articleTitle: Coordinated Dispatch Strategy for Different Types of Industrial Loads Participating in Power Grid Based on the Source-Load Complementary Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th New Energy and Energy Storage System Control Summit Forum (NEESSC)
abstract: Electric heavy-duty truck battery swapping stations, cement production, and aluminum electrolysis have high-energy-consuming industrial loads. Due to the barriers within the industrial load operating levels, there is a lack of effective dispatch strategies among different types of loads. To enhance the control flexibility of new power systems and the rapid adjustment capability of load resources, this paper first proposes a multivariate mixed Copula function to model and analyze the complementary characteristics of the load distribution resources among electric heavy-duty truck battery swapping stations, cement, and aluminum electrolysis. The study explores the complementary characteristics and capabilities of adjustable loads from different types of industrial loads. Subsequently, a joint adjustment method index is proposed based on the source-load complementary characteristics, and the coordinated scheduling strategy for different types of source-load participation in grid operation is studied. Finally, an example is provided to analyze the effectiveness of interactive coordination control of different types of industrial loads across various time scales.
